sinopsis.es: A partir de una visita al planetario, una niña queda obsesionada con el Sol, este ser omnipresente que todos los días le recuerda que todo tiene un final.
sinopsis.en: A young girl visits the Planetarium with her father and discovers that, in millions of years, the sun could absorb the Earth and extinguish everything. Since then, she develops an obsession with this omnipresent star, which reminds her every day that everything has an end.
